summary: Tested manage-teachers bulk actions bar position + new PDF export (frontend Playwright on public URL) and backend /api/teachers/export-selected/pdf (pytest, 5/5 passed). Backend PDF endpoint is fully correct. Frontend: bar is correctly pinned to viewport bottom (position:fixed, gap=0px, all bulk buttons visible incl. new PDF button), BUT the 'تصدير PDF' button downloads an .xlsx from the Excel endpoint — exportSelected() ignores the passed format argument.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'تصدير PDF' sends POST /api/teachers/export-selected (Excel) and downloads teachers_selected_<ts>.xlsx. Root cause: in /app/frontend/app/manage-teachers.tsx line 128 the function is declared `const exportSelected = async () => {` (no params) while callers use exportSelected('excel') / exportSelected('pdf') (lines 1026, 1035). Fix: accept `format: 'excel'|'pdf' = 'excel'`, hit `/api/teachers/export-selected${format==='pdf' ? '/pdf' : ''}`, and set a.download extension to .pdf for pdf.

action_items: Fix exportSelected() in manage-teachers.tsx to accept the format param and call /api/teachers/export-selected/pdf with .pdf filename for the PDF button
critical_code_review_comments: exportSelected() signature/call-site mismatch (silent TS/JS bug): callers pass a format string that is discarded — PDF button behaves identically to Excel.
PDF export path duplicates blob-download logic; extract a shared downloadBlob(url, filename) helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: manage-teachers does NOT hang on LoadingScreen; it intentionally shows 'اختر فلتراً لعرض المعلمين' until a department is chosen or search text entered + 'تطبيق الفلتر' clicked. For automation: login via fetch /api/auth/login then localStorage token/user, goto /manage-teachers, fill input[placeholder*='ابحث'] with a teacher name (DB has زين سالم, Saeed, حسن صالح), click 'تطبيق الفلتر', then click [data-testid^=teacher-select-]. Bulk bar verified position:fixed at viewport bottom.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend exportSelected() was never updated to a parameterized version, so both bulk export buttons call the Excel endpoint. Backend PDF endpoint returns 200 with %PDF, 400 for empty ids, 403 without token — verified by pytest.
